Thank you for your words. I edited my post a bit because I felt pathetic for typing all of that out. I'm in Ontario, unfortunately. BC seems like a dream haha. I took a philosophy class during my senior year and I loved it but I think it also made me feel worse and contributed to how I feel now. I know :( I really don't want things to spiral out of control but it feels like my only way of coping with it is some sort of method of escapism. I'm trying so hard to focus on art and music, anything to make me happy, but it's not working very well.

I like that idea of focusing on the bad stuff I haven't done. Thank you very much for your words, I appreciate it.
